action_summary: Withdraws the previous round's irreducible residual and measures why it appeared. Every run in this project began at reset; from a count of zero with unit steps, created_once and monotone-and-final-count-1 are the same sentence at any depth, so 203 fresh standard runs over three real tools disagree nowhere. Eighty pre-state experiments -- replay a real prefix, refuse the experiment unless the recorded pre-state is reproduced, execute one real atom -- separate the pair 25 times: 8 substantive (write the probe content, copy it: count 1 -> 2), 17 degenerate, of which 15 are no-ops the tool accepted and 2 are refusals. On the widened suite the goal's class falls from 2 minimal statements to 1, the conjunction, at a cost of 429 -> 649 behaviours. Price of the 'irreducible' bit: 2 actions, 0 questions of the user.
